basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Models a coordinated time-bound effort toward objectives through audiences, messages and channels, unlike a project that delivers an output.
Keeps reach, exposure, engagement, outcome and causal impact as separate assertions.
Versions audience criteria, suppression and safeguards with the campaign.
Excludes threat campaigns in security and paid advertising campaign objects as different classes.

may: Validate audience criteria against consent and suppression lists.
Plan waves and channels and draft message variants for approval.
Record delivery and result observations from channel reports.
Pause a wave when an adverse-effect threshold is reached and alert the owner.
mustNot: Launch or release campaign material without approval.
Target people without lawful basis or against suppression and opt-out.
Use sensitive traits or vulnerable-group status for targeting without safeguards.
Claim causal impact from reach or engagement figures alone.
Copy personal data from audience masters into the campaign record.
requiresHuman: Approving campaign launch, material and audience definitions.
Terminating a campaign or changing its objectives.
Any targeting of children or other vulnerable groups.

considerations: Persuasive messaging can manipulate people; targeting must respect autonomy and consent.
Exclusion or inclusion of groups in audiences can discriminate.
Public-interest campaigns need honest evaluation, not inflated reach figures.

items: A campaign has a name, a mandate, objectives, audiences, a time window and channels.
It is confused with a project, a single ad, a message, a cyber threat campaign or a programme.
Messages sent to people who opted out.
Harmful or misleading content released at scale.
IAB Tech Lab OpenRTB and Content Taxonomy for advertising channels.
UTM campaign parameters for tagging links by campaign, source and medium.
IETF List-Unsubscribe header (RFC 8058) for email opt-out.
